campaigns.title: Velox Activewear — Summer Sprint Drop
campaigns.description: High-energy training reel showing technical fit, moisture-wicking stretch, and unboxing performance wear in urban or outdoor tracks.
requirements: Hook within the first 2 seconds highlighting apparel
Show product close-ups with natural motion
Include hashtag #VeloxSpeed and tag @VeloxAthletics in caption

campaigns.title: Lumino Audio — Urban Commuter Wireless
campaigns.description: Minimalist aesthetic desk, commute, and city lifestyle showcase featuring active noise cancellation and sleek industrial finish.
requirements: Authentic everyday usage in commuting or workspace scene
Demonstrate touch gestures or active noise cancellation switch
Clear, crisp voiceover or trending lo-fi background audio

campaigns.title: Solstice Skincare — Dewy Morning Glow
campaigns.description: Clean aesthetic morning routine featuring the golden hydration serum. Soft daylight, texture swatch on skin, and authentic reaction.
requirements: Raw skin texture, no smoothing filters
Explain key ingredient benefit (hyaluronic acid + peptide)

campaigns.title: Spring Velocity '26 Campaign
campaigns.description: Sprint footwear testing and urban running communities taking over metropolitan streets.

campaigns.title: BioEnergy Pro Launch — Electrolyte Wave
campaigns.description: Pre-workout mix demonstration and mid-workout hydration boost.
requirements: Mix packet dissolved in water with transparent shaker

campaigns.title: Halo Living — Ambient Sunset Lamp Edition
campaigns.description: Editorial cozy evening desk setup transformation with the curved matte-black sunset lamp.
requirements: Desk lighting contrast before and after turning lamp on
Focus on ambient color dispersion against wall
